correctness.rationale: The Bernoulli shift representation converts falling into H_{s+k} into a zero run with length >=m+k+a_{s+k}; minimizing over offsets modulo q yields b_s exactly. Complete safe runs give finite nonnegative q-phase renewal matrix K_m(z); its spectral-radius singularity determines the exponential survival rate. For the uncapped matrix K_inf(z)=zP/2(I-zP/2)^-1, Perron eigenvalue is z/(2-z), left/right vectors uniform/all-ones, derivative 2 at z=1. Missing row mass is 2^-(m+b_s); finite-dimensional perturbation yields gamma_m=2^-m(2q)^-1 sum 2^-b_s+O_{q,a}(m4^-m). b_s<=a_s gives sharp general minimum; equality requires the cyclic reverse staircase, uniquely. Independent exact Fraction enumeration of all (q-1)! cyclic representatives for q=2,...,8 recovered maximum coefficients and counts (3/8,1);(1/3,1);(9/32,4);(1/4,10);(11/48,12);(23/112,144);(3/16,864), confirming finite exhaustive claims. No extrapolation to q>8 maxima.
